data.title: 吹雪 · 暴雪组的白色誓约
data.description: 【吹雪组玻璃温室·黄昏】吹雪穿着祖母绿与白色相间的礼服婚纱，站在盛放白玫瑰的温室中央；她一手整理珍珠项链，一手接过捧花，微笑从领导者的完美弧度变成只给镜头的轻微羞赧。
data.action: 白玫瑰温室里接过捧花整理珍珠项链，领导者微笑变成轻微羞赧
data.lighting: green-gold evening light through the glass roof
data.mood: 体面铠甲下的私人誓约
data.promptProse: Fubuki from One-Punch Man wears an emerald-and-white bridal gown with pearl jewelry, a structured veil and white rose bouquet. She stands among white roses in the greenhouse, accepting the bouquet with the composed grace of a leader. When she notices the viewer, her practiced smile eases into a restrained blush while the glass roof catches the last green-gold light. green-gold evening light through the glass roof.
